note: E2 A1 side check (not pre-registered; added after A1 showed encode_receiver p50 0.316 s vs 0.17-0.26 s in E1). Receiver-only encode timed alone (no MINT stages interleaved), 24-frame dev slice, per-frame median of 5 reps, 8 intra-op threads; two alternating fresh processes per setting. Development, in-sample.
